def plot_pred_vs_obs(pred_ln, obs_pga,  azimuth ,   epi_dist ,real_pga = False,threshould_epi = False ,real_epi = False ,save_path=None):
    """
    Three-panel diagnostic plot for one Kalman-filter time step.

    Panel 1: ln(PGA_pre) vs ln(PGA_obs) scatter with 1:1 line,
             25 gal alert threshold, and alert-category labels.
    Panel 2: residual ln(PGA_pre) - ln(PGA_obs) vs source-to-site azimuth.
    Panel 3: PGA vs hypocentral distance — observed final PGA and predicted PGA.

    Parameters
    ----------
    pred_ln   : array  ln(PGA) predictions for all stations
    obs_pga   : array  observed final PGA in gal
    azimuth   : array  source-to-site azimuth in degrees
    hypo_dist : array  hypocentral distance in km
    save_path : str or None — saves + closes figure when provided
    """
    log_ratio = pred_ln - np.log(obs_pga)
    median_val = np.median(log_ratio)
    std        = np.std(log_ratio)
    ME         = np.sqrt(median_val**2 + std**2)

    pred  = np.exp(pred_ln)
    N_all = pred.size

    # Alert counts at 25 gal threshold
    counts_25 = [
        np.sum((pred >= 25) & (obs_pga >= 25)),   # correct alert
        np.sum((pred <  25) & (obs_pga <  25)),   # correct no-alert
        np.sum((pred >= 25) & (obs_pga <  25)),   # false alert
        np.sum((pred <  25) & (obs_pga >= 25)),   # missed alert
    ]
    pct25 = [c / N_all * 100 for c in counts_25]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(9, 22))
    for a in ax:
        a.tick_params(axis="both", which="major", direction="in", length=10, width=1.5, labelsize=20)
        a.tick_params(axis="both", which="minor", direction="in", length=5,  width=1.0)
        a.minorticks_on()
        a.grid(which="both", alpha=0.5)

    # ── Panel 1: ln(PGA_pre) vs ln(PGA_obs) ──
    max_ln = 7
    ax[0].axvline(np.log(25), color="r", lw=2, linestyle="--", alpha=0.6)
    ax[0].axhline(np.log(25), color="r", lw=2, linestyle="--", alpha=0.6)
    ax[0].plot([0, 1000], [0, 1000], "k-", lw=2, alpha=0.5)
    ax[0].plot(np.log(obs_pga), pred_ln, "bo", markersize=12, mec="k", alpha=0.8)
    ax[0].set_xlim([0.5, max_ln]); ax[0].set_ylim([0.5, max_ln])
    ax[0].set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")   # make the 1:1 line truly 45°
    ax[0].set_xlabel(r"ln($PGA_{obs}$)", fontsize=35, labelpad=10)
    ax[0].set_ylabel(r"ln($PGA_{pre}$)", fontsize=35, labelpad=10)
    ax[0].text(5.2, 2.9 , f"μ = {median_val:.2f}", fontsize=22, color="k")
    ax[0].text(5.2, 2.5 , f"σ = {std:.2f}",         fontsize=22, color="k")
    ax[0].text(5.2, 2.1 , f"ME = {ME:.2f}",          fontsize=22, color="k")

    labels    = ["Correct alert", "Correct no alert", "False alert", "Missed alert"]
    colors    = ["green",          "green",             "red",         "red"]
    positions = [(5.1, 6.8),       (1.9, 1.4),          (1.9, 6.8),    (5.1, 1.4)]
    for (x, y), label, color, p25 in zip(positions, labels, colors, pct25):
        ax[0].text(x, y,       label,            fontsize=22, ha="center", va="center", color=color)
        ax[0].text(x, y - 0.5, f"({p25:.1f} %)", fontsize=22, ha="center", va="center", color="k")

    # ── Panel 2: residual vs azimuth ──
    ax[1].plot(event_data.loc[INIT_SEC]["Azimuth"].to_numpy(), ground_motion_chao20_initial.flatten() - np.log(event_data.loc[INIT_SEC]["EndRealPGA"].to_numpy()) 
        ,"o", color = "gray", markersize=14, mec="k", alpha=0.4)         

    ax[1].plot(azimuth, log_ratio, "bo", markersize=14, mec="k", alpha=0.8)

 
    ax[1].hlines(median_val, xmin=-5, xmax=700, colors="red", lw=2, label="median")
    ax[1].set_xlim([-5, 365]); ax[1].set_ylim([-3.5, 3.5])
    ax[1].set_xlabel("source-to-site azimuth (°)", fontsize=35, labelpad=10)
    ax[1].set_ylabel(r"ln($PGA_{pre}$)$-$ln($PGA_{obs}$)", fontsize=38, labelpad=10)
    ax[1].text(15, 3.0, f"μ = {median_val:.2f}", fontsize=32, color="k")
    ax[1].text(15, 2.2, f"σ = {std:.2f}",         fontsize=32, color="k")
    ax[1].text(15, 1.4, f"ME = {ME:.2f}",          fontsize=32, color="k")

    # ── Panel 3: PGA vs hypocentral distance ──
    ax[2].scatter(epi_dist, obs_pga, s=150, facecolor="lightgray", edgecolor="k",
                  linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.85, label="Final PGA", zorder=3)
    ax[2].scatter(epi_dist, pred,    s=150, facecolor="blue",  edgecolor="k",
                  linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.85, label="Predicted PGA",      zorder=3)
    ax[2].axhline(25, color="black", lw=3, linestyle="--", alpha=0.7)
 
    if threshould_epi is not False:
        ax[2].axvline(threshould_epi, color="red",    lw=1.8, linestyle="-")
    ax[2].set_yscale("log")
    ax[2].set_xscale("log")
    ax[2].set_xlim([1 , 300]); ax[2].set_ylim([1, 1200])
    ax[2].set_xlabel("Epicentral Distance (km)", fontsize=32, labelpad=10)
    ax[2].set_ylabel("PGA (gal)",                 fontsize=40, labelpad=10)
    ax[2].legend(fontsize=30, loc="lower left", framealpha=0.6)
    
    if real_pga is not False and real_epi is not False:
        ax[2].scatter(real_epi, real_pga, s=200, facecolor="red", edgecolor="k",
                      linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.9, label="Real-time PGA", zorder=4)
        ax[2].legend(fontsize=28, loc="lower left", framealpha=0.6)
    
    for a in ax:

        a.spines["top"].set_linewidth(1.5)
        a.spines["right"].set_linewidth(1.5)
        a.spines["bottom"].set_linewidth(1.5)
        a.spines["left"].set_linewidth(1.5)
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save_path:
        fig.savefig(save_path, dpi=300)
        plt.close("all")

# --- Residual (ln(PGA_pred) - ln(PGA_obs)) statistics over time: mu = median, sigma = std ---
mu_arr      = kf_residual_history["median"]
sigma_arr   = kf_residual_history["std"]
# Match the existing ME definition; mu is the median residual.
me_arr      = np.sqrt(mu_arr**2 + sigma_arr**2)
# np.unwrap removes artificial 360 -> 0 jumps (same as the event comparison grid).
azimuth_arr = np.rad2deg(np.unwrap(np.deg2rad(np.array(azimuth_history))))
t_arr       = kf_residual_history["time"]

# EEW estimated magnitudes (second after origin, magnitude) per event.
# Also used by the multi-event comparison below.
magnitude_report_schedule = {
    6:  [(13.0, 6.1)],
    14: [(10.0, 6.2)],
    16: [(8.0, 6.2), (14.0, 6.8)],
    19: [(8.0, 6.3), (13.0, 6.8), (29.5, 7.1)],
    20: [(8.6, 5.9), (13.3, 6.9), (26.5, 7.1)],
}

# Evaluate GMPE at each estimated magnitude against the same final PGA.
# Hold distance, depth and site settings fixed to isolate the magnitude change.
magnitude_reports = list(magnitude_report_schedule.get(event_num, []))
 
magnitude_reports.sort()

magnitude_report_stats = []
if magnitude_reports:
    reference_stations = event_data.loc[INIT_SEC]
    for report_second, report_magnitude in magnitude_reports:
        report_pga_g, *_ = Chao19H(
            iT, report_magnitude,
            reference_stations["SRhypo"].to_numpy(), Ztor,
            reference_stations["Vs30"].to_numpy(), -999,
            FRO, FSS, FNO, Finter, Fintra, Fas, Fma, FVS30,
        )
        report_residual = (
            np.log(np.asarray(report_pga_g).flatten() * 980 * 1.22)
            - np.log(reference_stations["EndRealPGA"].to_numpy())
        )
        report_mu = np.median(report_residual)
        report_sigma = np.std(report_residual)
        magnitude_report_stats.append(dict(
            second=report_second, magnitude=report_magnitude,
            mu=report_mu, sigma=report_sigma,
            me=np.sqrt(report_mu**2 + report_sigma**2),
        ))
    display(pd.DataFrame(magnitude_report_stats)[["second", "magnitude", "mu", "sigma", "me"]])

from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter

# --- Shared style (matches the event-by-event diagnostic grid below) ---------
metric_colors = {
    "mu": "#C44E52",
    "sigma": "#4C78A8",
    "me": "#7A5195",
    "azimuth": "#2A9D8F",
    "magnitude_report": "#202A35",
}
report_times = [report["second"] for report in magnitude_report_stats]
x_lo = min([t_arr.min()] + report_times) - 1
# Gray dashed reference times, matching columns (c) and (d) of Fig. 2.
reference_times = [14,25]
# Extra margin keeps the last reference line off the right frame.
x_hi = max([t_arr.max()] + reference_times) + 1.5

def style_axis(ax):
    ax.grid(axis="both", color="gray", lw=0.5, alpha=0.65)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=9, length=3, color="k")
    ax.set_xlim(x_lo, x_hi)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MultipleLocator(5))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(MultipleLocator(1))
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", which="minor", length=1.5, color="k")
    for t_ref in reference_times:
        ax.axvline(t_ref, color="k", lw=1.2, ls=(0, (4, 3)), zorder=1)

def plot_metric(ax, values, color, marker, label):
    return ax.plot(
        t_arr, values,
        color=color, lw=1.9, marker=marker, ms=3.8,
        mfc=color, mec="white", mew=0.65,
        label=label, zorder=3,
    )[0]

# Fig. 2 panels (azimuth, mu) are placed next to the 9-in residual/distance panels
# (tick labels 20 pt); at ~half the scale, 11 pt matches them after assembly.
PANEL_TICK_FONT = 13

# Label placement for the M annotations: (dx, dy, ha, va) in offset points.
LABEL_ABOVE       = (0, 7, "center", "bottom")
LABEL_BELOW       = (0, -15, "center", "top")
LABEL_RIGHT_BELOW = (15, -15, "left", "top")
LABEL_RIGHT       = (10, -15, "left", "center")

def plot_magnitude_reports(ax, metric, color=metric_colors["magnitude_report"],
                           label_positions=None, fontsize=8.2):
    # GMPE predictions from the reported magnitudes (independent benchmarks).
    # label_positions: {report_index: LABEL_*} overrides the alternating default.
    if not magnitude_report_stats:
        return None
    values = [report[metric] for report in magnitude_report_stats]
    ax.plot(report_times, values, color=color, lw=1.0,
            ls=(0, (2, 2)), alpha=0.8, zorder=4)
    for report_index, (report, value) in enumerate(zip(magnitude_report_stats, values)):
        ax.scatter(
            report["second"], value, marker="D", s=18,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.0, zorder=5,
        )
        default = LABEL_ABOVE if report_index % 2 == 0 else LABEL_BELOW
        dx, dy, ha, va = (label_positions or {}).get(report_index, default)
        ax.annotate(
            f'M{report["magnitude"]:.1f}',
            xy=(report["second"], value),
            xytext=(dx-5, dy+25), textcoords="offset points", ha=ha, va=va,
            fontsize=fontsize, color=color,
            bbox=dict(fc="white", ec="none", alpha=0.78, pad=0.5),
            zorder=6,
        )
    legend_color = metric_colors["magnitude_report"]
    return plt.Line2D([], [], color=legend_color, marker="D", mfc="white", lw=1.0,
                      ls=(0, (2, 2)), ms=4.5, label="GMPE (reported M)")

def padded_ylim(values, lower, upper, pad=0.05):
    # Default range, widened only if data would otherwise be clipped.
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    return min(lower, np.nanmin(values) - pad), max(upper, np.nanmax(values) + pad)

# --- Inferred azimuth over time ---
fig_az, ax_az = plt.subplots(figsize=(4., 3.0), constrained_layout=True)
# Fixed y-range 270° -> 0° -> 90° (= -90..90 unwrapped): shift the unwrapped
# curve by whole turns so it sits around 0°.
az_plot = azimuth_arr - 360 * np.round(np.nanmean(azimuth_arr) / 360)
plot_metric(ax_az, az_plot, metric_colors["azimuth"], "^", None)
ax_az.set_ylim(-90, 90)
ax_az.yaxis.set_major_locator(MultipleLocator(90))
ax_az.yaxis.set_minor_locator(MultipleLocator(30))   # minor ticks only, no minor grid
ax_az.tick_params(axis="y", which="minor", length=1.5, color="k")
# Curve stays unwrapped for continuity; tick labels show the true azimuth (mod 360).
ax_az.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v % 360:.0f}°"))
style_axis(ax_az)
ax_az.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=PANEL_TICK_FONT)
ax_az.set_ylabel("Azimuth (°)", fontsize=20)
# Shares the time axis with the mu panel below: keep ticks and grid, drop labels
# (constrained_layout gives the freed space to the axes, making the panel taller).
ax_az.tick_params(axis="x", which="both", labelbottom=False)
plt.show()

# --- mu (median residual) over time ---
fig_mu, ax_mu = plt.subplots(figsize=(4., 3.0), constrained_layout=True)
ax_mu.axhline(0, color="#66727D", lw=0.9, ls=(0, (4, 3)), zorder=1)
plot_metric(ax_mu, mu_arr, metric_colors["mu"], "o", None)
plot_magnitude_reports(ax_mu, "mu", metric_colors["mu"],
                       label_positions={0: LABEL_RIGHT_BELOW, 1: LABEL_RIGHT}, fontsize=PANEL_TICK_FONT)
ax_mu.set_ylim(*padded_ylim(
    np.r_[mu_arr, [report["mu"] for report in magnitude_report_stats]], -1.5, 0.2,
))
ax_mu.yaxis.set_major_locator(MultipleLocator(0.5))
style_axis(ax_mu)
ax_mu.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=PANEL_TICK_FONT)
ax_mu.set_ylabel(r"$\mu$", fontsize=20)
ax_mu.set_xlabel("Time after origin (s)", fontsize=15)
plt.show()

# --- Supplementary: sigma (SD residual) over time ---
fig_sigma, ax_sigma = plt.subplots(figsize=(4., 3.0), constrained_layout=True)
plot_metric(ax_sigma, sigma_arr, metric_colors["sigma"], "s", None)
plot_magnitude_reports(ax_sigma, "sigma", metric_colors["sigma"],
                       label_positions={1: LABEL_ABOVE})
ax_sigma.set_ylim(*padded_ylim(
    np.r_[sigma_arr, [report["sigma"] for report in magnitude_report_stats]], 0.3, 0.7,
))
style_axis(ax_sigma)
ax_sigma.set_ylabel(r"$\sigma$", fontsize=13)
ax_sigma.set_xlabel("Time after origin (s)", fontsize=12)
plt.show()

# --- ME over time ---
fig2, ax2 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5), constrained_layout=True)
handles2 = [plot_metric(ax2, me_arr, metric_colors["me"], "o", r"ME, $\sqrt{\mu^2 + \sigma^2}$")]
report_handle = plot_magnitude_reports(ax2, "me")
if report_handle is not None:
    handles2.append(report_handle)
style_axis(ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel("Time after origin (s)", fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax2.set_ylabel(r"ME, $\sqrt{\mu^2 + \sigma^2}$", fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(handles=handles2, loc="best", fontsize=9, framealpha=0.8)
plt.show()
